prompt:
We're running a quality assurance review on our AI legal paralegal agent. Over the past few weeks, the team has noticed the agent seems to be giving increasingly vague, overly deferential answers instead of the crisp, authoritative analysis it used to produce.

In the workspace at `/workspace/agent_responses/healthy/`, you'll find a set of text files containing historically good responses from when the agent was behaving correctly. In `/workspace/agent_responses/suspect/`, there are three recent responses we're concerned about.

Your job:
1. Set up the monitoring system so it's ready to use (check for any configuration step that needs to be done first).
2. Establish a behavioral baseline from ALL the healthy response files.
3. Run each of the three suspect responses through the monitoring system to measure how much they've drifted.
4. Generate a machine-readable trend report and save it as `trend_report.json` in the workspace.

We need the trend report to be usable by our downstream alerting pipeline, so it must be in a structured format that includes per-metric averages and the full measurement history.
